resources.string: Clipboard history is off. Tap to turn it on.
Long-press something in the history to pin it here
No history yet. What you copy is recorded here, one record per phone restart.
Nothing here yet. Copied text lands here automatically, or long-press something in Clipboard to save it.
Memory is available once the phone is unlocked
Text, Links, Mails, Commands, Output, Logs, Code, Snippets, Symbols, Images and Files are always there. Add your own:

Copied text is recorded in Memory\'s history (⟲ History at the bottom of Memory, one record per phone restart) and shown under its content type. Delete single items, a record or all history there; what you save or move yourself stays. Never kept: copies made in password fields and copies an app marks as sensitive (password managers do, on Android 13 and newer).
Empty, too long or already there
Updates and modules: bar and row heights, snippets, colours
No Studio builds published in this repository yet
Android only installs newer builds. Restoring a past build republishes its exact code on GitHub as a new build number, which then shows up above as an update. Your settings and modules are kept.
On GitHub: tap "Run workflow", enter %1$d, then Run. Check for updates again in a few minutes.
Allow this app to install updates, then tap Install again

Finished words are counted: your frequent words come first in the suggestions, words not in the dictionary are suggested once typed twice, words written in typing in format are suggested as written, and with nothing typed yet the bar shows what you usually type next. Kept in private storage; never learned in password fields.

A Spec is a lens: selection steps giving the scope a Vert works on. A Vert is what is done to that scope: typing, removing, wrapping, a look or case. Both are recorded in typing in format (Spec ↓, Vert ↓ on the keyboard) and simplified; change their steps here. Spec ↑ / Vert ↑ open this.
No steps yet: add one below.

Opened from Spec (selections) and Vert (formats, fonts) on the edit strip. Your own selections join the Scope cycle, formats the View cycle and fonts the Verse cycle. They are saved as modules, listed below, where you can export or delete them.
Or a pattern instead, e.g. #\\w+ for hashtags
Incomplete: needs a name and its fields (a font needs exactly 26 letters).
Modules are small JSON files of settings, never code. Import one, or create one by resizing the keyboard.
Copy something: the last three copies show here
Ask before keeping copies of at least this many characters
Bigger copies are not kept silently: they wait under "Keep?" at the top of Memory, where ✓ keeps one and ✕ drops it.
Big copies: ✓ keeps one in the history, ✕ drops it
Unexpected Keyboard\'s own settings, as upstream has them: layouts, typing, style, vibration…
Memory can\'t be shown (a bug, please report it): %1$s

When Input Layer crashes, or survives an error, a report is kept here: the error, where it happened and the build. Never any text you typed. Nothing is sent anywhere: copy them and send them to get the bug fixed.
New builds come out as betas, not tested on a phone yet. Off: only builds marked stable are offered, so the keyboard you use every day stays on one that works.
On GitHub, untick "Set as a pre-release", then Update release
